experiencePlan.opening: A Little Less Sixteen Candles A Little More Touch Me is performed by Fall Out Boy.
experiencePlan.closing: Fall Out Boy's "A Little Less Sixteen Candles A Little More Touch Me" reached #65 on the Billboard Hot 100. "A Little Less Sixteen Candles, a Little More "Touch Me"" is a song by American rock band Fall Out Boy and the third and last single taken from their second studio album, From Under the Cork Tree (2005). The song peaked at #65 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.
